expressions.title: The Control of Shipping (Amendment) Act, 1949
expressions.title_basis: p1 block 1046431 is the Gazette running head (page 202, March 22, 1949); block 1046432 prints 'ACT No. XIV OF 1949 An Act to amend the Control of Shipping Act, 1947'; s.1 (block 1046435) names it the Control of Shipping (Amendment) Act, 1949; it ends at s.2 (block 1046441, the substituted sub-section (3)). Blocks 1046442-1046457 print ACT No. XV OF 1949, the Salaries and Allowances of Ministers Act, 1949, which is the catalogued law of document 8112 (the same Gazette page, split there as its primary) -- set aside as apparatus here so the law is not duplicated (owner policy q1 'split').
